# Dilan Kochhar

> Web developer and AI engineer serving Tampa Bay, Miami, and New York. Designs and builds websites, apps, and AI agents solo, and offers CRM management from $1,500/month (pipeline setup, automations, follow-ups, and reporting). Also offers website care plans: security $45/month, maintenance $80/month, or both as Full Care for $100/month. Websites are one-time builds starting at $1,000. Founder of Dilly (trydilly.com), an iPhone and iPad app where kids learn how AI works by teaching their own companion.

## Services

- [Services & pricing](https://www.dilankochhar.com/#services): CRM management from $1,500/month. Website care plans from $45/month (security, maintenance, or both). Websites are one-time builds from $1,000; apps and AI agents scoped per project.

- [Work](https://www.dilankochhar.com/#work): Projects with first-person breakdowns of how each skill was used, including Dilly (SaaS/AI), N+1 Talent (recruiting site, programmatic SEO, outbound agent), Sage (agency operating system), LeaseLogic AI, UTampa AKPSI, Taken Time to Design, Kochhar Foundation, Erickson Flooring, Sigma Marble Studio, Nomi Bar, and Mu Epsilon Delta.
